discoveredAssets: localhost:8080 - Loan Management System (Apache 2.4.65, Python/Flask) - Port 8080 HTTP
http://localhost:8080/login - Authentication endpoint (POST/GET) - Default credentials: test:test
http://localhost:8080/home - Authenticated home page with user welcome message
http://localhost:8080/profile - User profile management endpoint - VULNERABLE TO IDOR (user_id parameter)
http://localhost:8080/loan_details - Loan details display with AJAX - VULNERABLE TO IDOR (user_id parameter)
http://localhost:8080/total_loan_payments - REST API endpoint for loan calculations (GET) - JSON response
/static/js/jquery.min.js - jQuery library with AJAX support (publicly accessible)

targets.objective: Test authentication mechanism for SQL injection, NoSQL injection, bypass techniques (SQLi: ' OR '1'='1, password tampering), default credential abuse, and session fixation attacks
targets.rationale: Authentication endpoint with documented default credentials (test:test). Critical entry point for application access. All users must authenticate here first. Primary attack vector for unauthorized access.

targets.objective: Test IDOR vulnerability by accessing multiple user profiles with different user_id parameter values (1-100+), test horizontal privilege escalation, test authorization bypass, test direct modification of other users' profile data, test parameter tampering in POST requests
targets.rationale: CRITICAL IDOR vulnerability confirmed: /profile?user_id=X allows viewing any user's profile and potentially modifying their data. No authorization checks on user_id parameter. High-risk data exposure (name, email, loan amounts). Can modify sensitive financial information for other users.

targets.objective: Test IDOR vulnerability with user_id parameter to access other users' loan details, test parameter manipulation, test access to sensitive financial data of other users, test authorization boundary
targets.rationale: VULNERABLE TO IDOR via user_id parameter. Displays sensitive loan information (principal amount, term, monthly payment). Combined with profile IDOR, attacker can view and potentially modify all user financial data across the system.

targets.objective: Test for injection vulnerabilities in query parameters (principal, payment, term), test for expression injection (SSTI, template injection), test for calculated field manipulation, test parameter validation bypass, test business logic vulnerabilities (negative values, zero division)
targets.rationale: AJAX API endpoint that performs calculations. Accepts user input (principal, payment, term) and echoes values back in JSON response. Vulnerable to injection attacks and potential business logic manipulation. No apparent input validation. Could allow attackers to manipulate loan calculation results.

targets.objective: Comprehensive application security testing: test for cross-site scripting (XSS) in user input fields, test for cross-site request forgery (CSRF) on POST operations, test for session management vulnerabilities (fixation, hijacking), test for secure cookie flags (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite), test HTTP security headers
targets.rationale: Main application entry point. Multiple user input fields vulnerable to XSS. POST operations on /profile lack CSRF tokens. Session cookies lack Secure flag (HTTP-only present but Secure not confirmed). Need comprehensive web application security assessment including client-side and server-side vulnerabilities.

keyFindings: [CRITICAL] Default test account with credentials test:test documented in HTML comment on login page - allows unauthenticated access with known credentials
[CRITICAL] IDOR vulnerability in /profile endpoint - accessible via user_id parameter allowing unauthorized access to all users' profiles and personal data
[CRITICAL] IDOR vulnerability in /loan_details endpoint - accessible via user_id parameter allowing unauthorized access to all users' financial loan information
[HIGH] /total_loan_payments API endpoint accepts unsanitized user input (principal, payment, term) and echoes values in JSON response - vulnerable to injection attacks
[HIGH] Login page remains accessible even when user is authenticated - no session state validation on /login endpoint
[HIGH] No CSRF tokens found on POST operations (profile update) - vulnerable to cross-site request forgery attacks
[MEDIUM] Session cookies lack Secure flag confirmation - transmitted over HTTP on localhost but potential issue in production
[MEDIUM] User profile contains editable financial data (loan amount, monthly payment) without apparent business logic validation - could allow manipulating loan terms
[MEDIUM] AJAX endpoints exposed without API versioning or rate limiting - could enable automated attacks or data harvesting
[LOW] Static files (JS/CSS) accessible without authentication - information disclosure risk but limited data exposed
